Janakana Maathu Shiradali Audio Song From The Classic Kannada Movie Oda Huttidavaru, Featuring Dr. Rajkumar And Ambareesh. Enjoy This Memorable Kannada Song With Music Composed By The Renowned Music Director Upendra Kumar.
Relive The Nostalgic Charm Of Classic Kannada Cinema And Enjoy This Memorable Song From Oda Huttidavaru.
Directed by: Dorai–Bhagavan
Produced by: S. P. Varadaraj
Written by: S. K. Bhagavan
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Ambareesh, Madhavi, Srishanti
Music Director: Upendrakumar
Cinematography: B. C. Gowrishankar
